name: B10-0409/2025 (ECR) – Declaration of principles for a gender-equal society
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the declaration of principles for a gender-equal society
part_text:
The European Parliament gives its opinion on the Commission's declaration of principles for a gender-equal society. It welcomes the declaration's overall goals but says mothers are not supported enough. It criticises quota systems and affirmative action as unfair. It asks the Commission and Council to condemn commercial exploitation of women's bodies, especially surrogacy. It asks member states to protect women's safety, including at borders, and to set up early childhood care so women who want children can have them in good conditions. It also defends parents' freedom to educate their children.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position on the Commission's declaration.
- It affects the Commission, member states and parents; no direct effect on citizens yet.
- Next, the resolution goes to the Commission; no further steps are set out.
